**Sharper Signals.** v1.21.0 is the first production release of the fork's staged detection-intelligence work. It adds evidence-aware detections, per-type alert rules, persistent device policies, chronological event history, RSSI trend tools, multi-target HUNT, stronger Remote ID/Flock/tracker handling, safer BLE identity migration, screen-only privacy, and a broad UI/reliability pass. CYD BLE OTA remains intentionally supported.

## Added

- **Detection evidence and repeat intelligence.** BLE and Wi-Fi detections now retain compact evidence describing what matched, plus a uniform sighting/repeat count where appropriate.
- **Short RSSI history and trend analysis.** Live detections retain an allocation-free ~15-second RSSI history. HUNT uses the shared classifier for **GETTING WARMER / HOLDING STEADY / GETTING COLDER**, while LOG can show a compact direction indicator and mini sparkline.
- **Per-type Alert Rules.** Every detection type can independently choose full alert or **LOG ONLY**, minimum confidence, minimum repeats, cooldown, and whether an alert may wake the screen. Defaults preserve v1.20.1 behavior.
- **Persistent Device Policies.** Devices can be NORMAL, IGNORE, TRUSTED, or ALWAYS ALERT. Existing legacy ignore data migrates forward instead of being discarded.
- **Chronological EVENTS history inside LOG.** LOG now offers DEVICES and EVENTS views. EVENTS walks BlackBox history newest-first without adding a second persistent database or changing the BlackBox record format.
- **Multi-target HUNT.** WATCH and HUNT are now separate controls. HUNT can hold up to eight BLE/Wi-Fi targets, shows a count in the title-bar pill, sorts the roster by RSSI, and keeps the rest of the roster when one target is opened or stopped.
- **Screen-only PRIVACY MODE.** A persisted SYSTEM setting masks names and on-screen MAC suffixes across scans, alerts, LOG, WATCH/HUNT, ignore/policy views, desk alerts and related UI while preserving the real identifiers internally for tracking, BlackBox, SD/wardrive data and console behavior.
- **Expanded Remote ID/drone recognition.** Adds ASTM F3411 BLE Service Data handling, single-message and Message Pack support, Wi-Fi Beacon Remote ID, OpenDroneID NAN recognition, Parrot Remote ID validation, and curated drone-manufacturer IEEE prefixes with exact MA-L / MA-M matching.
- **Tracker SpamWatch.** Rapidly rotating AirTag, Samsung SmartTag, Google Find My and Tile identities can be recognized as one tracker flood so the device explains the event once instead of repeatedly interrupting. WATCH and ALWAYS ALERT remain explicit exceptions.
- **GPS-safe ADC console diagnostics.** Classic ESP32 CYD builds gain an `ADC` console command that averages spare input readings and refuses to sample GPIO35 when a GPS build is using it as GPS RX.
- **Seven status-light brightness levels.** Two extra-low PWM levels were added, and saved five-level settings migrate to their equivalent new values.
- **SquachMesh crypto host verification.** A real crypto host-test target and mbedTLS 2/3 compatibility shim were added alongside improved header dependency tracking.

## Improved

- **Flock Safety signatures.** The Flock matcher now uses refreshed field prefixes, confidence tiers, wildcard-probe corroboration and constrained Qualcomm evidence instead of stale broad guesses. Penguin battery local-name recognition was also improved.
- **BLE identity correctness.** Advertised names are parsed with lifetime-safe helpers, and BLE addresses are normalized to conventional human-readable MAC order before display/storage/comparison.
- **Legacy BLE compatibility.** Device policies, Regulars and historical BlackBox rows written with the old reversed BLE address order remain usable. Regular entries can migrate to canonical order when seen again.
- **Ignored-device feedback.** LOG visibly marks ignored devices and presents UNIGNORE when that is the current action.
- **BLACKBOX forensic console.** The console dump can traverse the full ring and print CLR markers in sequence while the normal on-device LOG continues to respect the latest clear boundary.
- **T-Watch settings.** Watch-only controls live under a dedicated WATCH SETTINGS page, and BUZZ now supports OFF / LOW / MED / HIGH with compatible migration from the old ON/OFF setting.
- **Settings organization.** Group headings are now stable labels instead of collapsible controls, avoiding hidden rows and accidental section collapse.
- **UI hit targets.** Bottom controls now respond through the actual bottom edge of the display, including raw scan and WATCH-alert actions.
- **Long-text fitting.** Raw-scan names, alert-card labels, diagnostics and toast text fit more safely; truncation is explicit and toast subtext can wrap.
- **LOG clear safety.** Clearing LOG now requires a confirming second press instead of being a one-tap destructive action.
- **Main-screen toast visibility.** Transient toasts render above the persistent time-zone card rather than being painted over.
- **Brightness controls.** APPEARANCE screen `-` and `+` touch zones now match the glyphs that are actually drawn, fixing the case where tapping the visible plus could dim the display.
- **RSSI UX consistency.** ALERT focuses on immediate facts, LOG keeps compact trend context, and HUNT owns the full-screen movement guidance so all three surfaces present signal information consistently.
- **Documentation/release clarity.** README and release-development documentation were reorganized around released vs. unreleased work, supported hardware, install flow, and selective upstream reconciliation.

## Detection-intelligence details

The staged v1.21 work was deliberately implemented without changing the existing BlackBox or SD record formats.

- Stage A: evidence, uniform repeats, short RSSI history and trend classification.
- Stage B: per-type alert rules with LOG ONLY, confidence, repeats, cooldown and wake controls.
- Stage C: compact persistent IGNORE / TRUSTED / ALWAYS ALERT policies with legacy migration.
- Stage D: DEVICES / EVENTS views inside LOG using the existing BlackBox history.
- Stage E: compact live RSSI sparklines and shared movement classification.

## Compatibility and release policy

- **CYD BLE OTA is retained.** This fork intentionally does not adopt upstream's CYD BLE-OTA removal.
- Existing v1.20.x device-policy / ignore data is migrated forward where applicable.
- Legacy reversed BLE MAC data remains readable after canonical address normalization.
- Existing BlackBox and SD log record formats are unchanged by the detection-intelligence stages.
- The released hardware matrix remains the established production set: 2.8-inch CYD variants, 3.2-inch resistive CYD, Freenove 3.2-inch, AWOK 2.4-inch, RL Phantom 2.4-inch resistive, and LilyGo T-Watch S3 beta, plus the existing optional 80 MHz display variants.
- Open development PRs are not part of this release. In particular, optional external CYD GPS variants, newer capacitive-board profiles, T-Watch S3 Plus GNSS/wardrive work, later time-zone changes, newer CrowPanel/Freenove-S3 board work, and other still-open reconciliation items remain development-only.

## Release gate

A real `v1.21.0` tag must point at the commit whose `VERSION` is exactly `1.21.0`. The release workflow will then build the release board matrix, require the production OTA signing key, sign OTA-capable firmware, validate manifests/assets, build the browser emulator and Pages artifact, and publish the GitHub Release only after those steps succeed.
